findings.issue: ריח ניחחי is an odor with a soothing/quieting quality. «olor de mi reposo» turns that quality into rest as the thing smelled.
מועד remains open among appointed time, place, and meeting. «tiempo señalado» resolves it to a designated time.
«para» marks purpose. The preposition on the hiphil infinitive can instead complete שמר as observe-to-bring-near.

notes: 2ms צו/ואמרת and 2mp תשמרו as guardarán (ustedes) keep the sons of Israel as the addressees.
